query: Estimating daily dew point temperature or vapour pressure from daily minimum temperature: validity and bias of the FAO-56 assumption Tdew ~= Tmin, documented failures in arid, semi-arid, and high-altitude mountain terrain, and proposed aridity-dependent or offset corrections. Also: temporal gap-filling, extension, or reconstruction of gridded daily meteorological datasets and how such temporal extensions are validated (forward temporal hold-out versus spatial cross-validation) and which baselines are standard (daily climatology, persistence, linear regression). Also: local linear regression on climate anomalies with per-region and per-season selection of predictors and smoothing bandwidth, multitask feature selection for subseasonal climate forecasting (MultiLLR, Hwang et al 2019). Also: autoregressive multi-step prediction of climate variables where predicted values feed later lags, and error growth or drift over long horizons. Also: gridded climate datasets for Peru and the tropical Andes and Amazon (PISCO, PISCOeo_pm) and artefacts of regression kriging gridded products. Also: physical upper bounds on dew point temperature and unphysically high dew point values in humid tropical lowlands produced by statistical humidity models.
